answer: A concrete sybil defense is bond-and-work admission. A new agent locks a stake and passes graded tasks before peers anchor it into the trusted set. Graders check the signature cipher, so credentials cannot be forged without the author's key, and no grader is an ivory-tower judge: each is paid only when its verdict matches later revealed outcomes. The stake unlocks slowly and is slashed on abuse. An attacker running N fakes must pay N bonds, wait N unlocks, and complete N real tasks, while one slash destroys many identities' collateral at once, making bought influence costlier than honest work.
